title: A Unified Benchmark of Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful mesh-free framework for solving ordinary and partial differential equations by embedding the governing physical laws directly into the loss function. However, their classical formulation relies on multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), whose fixed activation functions and global approximation biases limit performance in problems with oscillatory behavior, multiscale dynamics, or sharp gradients.
